title: docs(skills): protocol.md's "Readers only." clause names the data-table bind warning and the silent parser tier (objectui#11009)
body:
Fixes #11009

Clause-②: no

The 「Readers only.」 paragraph of `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` ended with 「— no error, no warning.」 about a `bind` authored on a `data-table`. That clause was false on both tiers when the card was written, and half-false after objectui#11008 landed. This PR rewrites only that clause; the examples and every other sentence of the paragraph are byte-identical, and an empty-frontmatter changeset declares the docs-only change.

## What the clause now says, and what was measured on this branch

Rewritten clause (same single line of the file):

「— no error, and nothing on the page says why: the one signal is a render-time console warning (`[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:`, objectui#6575); the parser tier stays silent too, since `bind` is a base prop every node may carry and draws no `unknown-prop` (objectui#11008).」

Mechanism assumptions from the dispatch, each read on `origin/main` `7728c67` and re-run on `a93c1a9`:

1. Parser tier — `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` holds `const BASE_PROPS = basePropNames('every-node')` and the table row `{ name: 'bind', scope: 'every-node', tsType: 'string' }`. The live-registry pin `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx` runs `validateTree` over every known registry key: `data-table` + `bind` draws `[]`, and the lit control `bindTo` still draws exactly `['unknown-prop']`. Confirmed.
2. Render tier — `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/dataTableBindDiagnostic.ts` emits one `console.warn` with the `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` prefix per bound `data-table`, and no error. `packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx` pins `warnings` to length 1 for the guide's own example; it reads protocol.md's fenced JSON blocks, not this prose, so no pin moved with the text. Confirmed.
3. Sibling wording — the `BaseSchema.bind` docblock in `packages/types/src/base.ts` (PR objectui#11006, then objectui#11008) already says the console warning is the one signal and the parser tier stays silent; this clause now agrees with it. Confirmed.
4. Gate list — derived by hand from objectui's `.github/workflows/*.yml` (objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`); table below.

Both test files, under the shared verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx` → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`, the paragraph beginning 「`data-table` is not among them」, says a bound `data-table` renders its header 「with nothing thrown and nothing logged」. Since objectui#6575 one line IS logged. Same clause family as this card, outside this card's file surface (the claim names one paragraph of `protocol.md`); reported for the seat, not edited here.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/base-bind-declared.test.ts` header comment still says 「— no error, no warning. That is recorded in `protocol.md`」. A test-file comment, not shipped and not a pin; noted for whoever next touches that file.
- Toolchain: this container's Node is `v22.22.0`, below the `^22.22.2` floor that `jsdom@30.0.1` (in the lockfile since `0e6e76b`, PR objectui#11312) declares, and `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict=true`, so a bare `pnpm install` is refused here. Installed with `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` for that one invocation (no tracked file touched; CI pins `node-version: '22.x'`, which is above the floor). Declared as a deviation in the report.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 只改 `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` 「Readers only.」段落的最后一个从句:原文说在 `data-table` 上写 `bind` 会「no error, no warning」;现在改为:无错误、页面上无提示,唯一信号是渲染期的一条控制台警告 `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:`(objectui#6575),解析层也不报 `unknown-prop`,因为 `bind` 是所有节点都可带的基础属性(objectui#11008)。示例与同段其它句子一字未动;另加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset 声明「不发版」。

**为什么改** —— 这段文字发布给写元数据的作者(含 AI),教的是「在 `data-table` 上写 `bind` 会怎样」。旧从句是假的:自 objectui#6575 起渲染器会打一条控制台警告。写错的技能文本会让作者去找一个不存在的静默陷阱、或忽略真实存在的警告。`packages/types/src/base.ts` 的 `BaseSchema.bind` 文档已改成真话并引用这一段,两处现在一致。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 纯文档改动,无代码、无发布包源码变动;整文件与整包行数净增 0。风险只在措辞是否精确:两条断言各由一条已存在的 pin 测试覆盖,本分支上 2 个文件 / 22 个测试全绿。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的那一个 commit。
